description: Sign-in, MFA, PAM, and identity governance for all 45,000 workforce users and the OT support jump servers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every division business system and the OT DMZ jump paths authenticate through SYS-G1; no sign-in means no production accounting, dispatch, or market bidding
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts per critical system; local OT accounts at each control center for on-site operators
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by every process below; OT control rooms keep local logons so control does not depend on SYS-G1

business_process: Cloud landing zones, WAN, and site connectivity
description: Network hubs, guardrails, keys, and logging in providers A and B; WAN links to control centers, plants, and field offices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Field data capture, shipper portal, market systems, and historian replicas run behind the hubs; control centers need WAN for corporate links (not for control)
manual_workaround: Cellular failover at field offices; control centers run without WAN (control traffic stays on OT networks)
dependent_third_parties: Cloud providers A and B; carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Cloud platform and network operations teams
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-P4, SYS-M3, SYS-E3, SYS-G6; links from IOC, PCC, GCC to corporate

business_process: Security monitoring and incident response (IT and OT desks)
description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR, OT monitoring console, and incident handling for all divisions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Notice clocks (NERC E-ISAC, PHMSA 1-hour, EPA immediate, Form 8-K Item 1.05, state laws) keep running during an outage; OT blind spots let an intruder reach control systems
manual_workaround: Retainer firm tooling; OT sensor consoles readable locally at the IOC, PCC, and GCC
dependent_third_parties: SIEM and EDR vendors; forensic retainer
dependent_people_or_facilities: SOC analysts; OT desk; division liaisons
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions depend on the SOC for detection and the facts behind every notice

description: H2S alarms, tank high-level alarms (the SPCC option in 40 CFR 112.9(c)(4)(iv) at about 250 batteries), and spill detection reported through field SCADA
process_owner: Production Vice President of Operations Technology
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Hardwired shutdowns still act locally, but the control room loses sight of alarms; SPCC compliance at about 250 batteries relies on the alarm reaching SCADA
manual_workaround: Shut in batteries that depend on SCADA alarms, or post gaugers on 4-hour rounds; portable H2S monitors for crews
dependent_people_or_facilities: Production controllers; lease operators; HSE staff
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on SYS-G2 OT desk for detection and on PCC coordination for spills on gathering lines

description: GCC dispatch of P1, P2, and P3; unit commitment and setpoints from the market operators and Balancing Authorities
process_owner: Power Generation Vice President of Generation (CIP Senior Manager)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Dispatch instructions arrive continuously; missing them causes deviation charges and reliability concerns for the Balancing Authority
manual_workaround: Backup GCC function in the P1 control room; telephone dispatch from the market operator; plants hold last setpoint under local control
dependent_third_parties: Market operators; Balancing Authorities; telecom carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: GCC operators (24x7); plant control room operators
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Corporate WAN carries no control traffic; GCC depends on SYS-G1 only for corporate tools

description: DCS and turbine control at P1, P2, and P3; startup, load following, and shutdown
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Loss of DCS trips units; a plant cannot run without its control system. Daily configuration backups set the RPO
manual_workaround: Redundant controllers; local panels for safe shutdown; OEM field engineers on call
dependent_people_or_facilities: Plant operators and instrument and control technicians
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Fuel gas from the third-party processor (residue gas made from the Production division associated gas); no shared IT dependency for control

description: Pipeline Control Center (PCC) control of the 140-mile trunk line, 4 pump stations, and breakout tanks at the Central Terminal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without SCADA the trunk line is shut down under the control room procedures; Permian takeaway then falls and Production must cut rates within about 12 hours as tanks fill
manual_workaround: Shut down and isolate; backup PCC at the Mid-Continent Operations Center; field technicians at pump stations for local operation only under the emergency procedures
dependent_third_parties: Telecom carriers; third-party market hub terminal
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Carries about 40% of Permian crude from the Production division; shippers rely on it

description: Enterprise field SCADA at the Permian IOC, the BCC, and the Florida control room: monitoring and remote start, stop, and speed control of wells, batteries, and compressors
process_owner: Production Vice President of Operations Technology
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Each hour of shut-in production costs about $1.6 million; manual operation sustains about 70% of output for a few days with extra crews
manual_workaround: Manual rounds by lease operators; shut in high-risk wells; run compressors locally
dependent_third_parties: SCADA vendor; private LTE and cellular carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: About 140 production controllers; field operations crews
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Historian replica feeds SYS-G6; takeaway depends on Crude Logistics (BP-ML01, BP-ML04)

business_process: Gathering system operation and leak detection
description: PCC monitoring of about 2,300 miles of gathering lines, computational leak detection, and remote valve control
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Leak detection is blind without SCADA; a release on a gathering line must be reported (PHMSA Subpart B; EPA 40 CFR 110.6) and is found later without it
manual_workaround: Patrol high-consequence segments; shut in affected gathering segments; rely on field pressure alarms
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Production batteries deliver into the gathering system; spills coordinated with Production HSE

description: Operation of the fields acquired 2025-09-30 on the legacy SCADA (SYS-P5) until migration
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 22% of production; legacy servers back up nightly to a local device (RPO 24 hours); restores never tested
manual_workaround: Manual rounds; shut in remote wells
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Not connected to the group SIEM; reachable from the shared jump servers (gap 1)

description: 38 injection plants and 600 disposal wells taking about 1.4 million barrels of produced water per day
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Producing wells must shut in when disposal capacity is lost; injection permits limit pressures that the SCADA enforces
manual_workaround: Truck water to third-party disposal; reduce rates
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Water hauling by Crude Logistics trucks

business_process: Truck dispatch and electronic run tickets
description: Dispatch of about 1,150 crude trucks; electronic run tickets at pickup and unloading
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Leases without pipeline connections fill their tanks in 2 to 3 days; run tickets are the custody record
manual_workaround: Paper run tickets and radio dispatch from regional terminals
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Production leases depend on trucks; tickets feed SYS-P3 volumes

description: Shared jump servers used by OT support staff and approved vendors of all three divisions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Needed for remote OT troubleshooting and vendor support during recovery, not for routine control
manual_workaround: Support staff travel to control centers and plants
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Reaches all three divisions OT DMZs (gap 1); in P08 it is a spread path, so it is restored only after it is rebuilt

description: About 140 LACT units and truck unloading stations, flow computers, and the measurement data system
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Flow computers keep about 35 days of data locally; shippers are invoiced on measured volumes
manual_workaround: Read flow computers locally; reconcile later
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Volumes feed SYS-P3 (Production) and shipper statements (SYS-M3)

description: Day-ahead and real-time offers, schedules, and settlement checks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Day-ahead offers are due once a day; a missed window idles units or forces default offers
manual_workaround: Submit offers through the market operator backup interface or by phone where allowed
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Runs on SYS-G3 (provider A) and SYS-G1 sign-in

description: ELDs, GPS, and driver-facing cameras for about 1,150 trucks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Drivers need hours-of-service records to keep driving; camera and GPS data support safety and en route security
manual_workaround: Paper logs under the carrier ELD malfunction procedure; radio check-ins
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Feeds dispatch (BP-ML04)

business_process: Field data capture and volume integration
description: Tank gauges, run tickets, and well tests captured on tablets; daily allocated volumes sent to hydrocarbon accounting
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Volumes drive state production reports and revenue; daily capture can be rebuilt from paper and flow computers
manual_workaround: Paper gauge sheets; flow computer reads
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Run tickets from Crude Logistics (BP-ML04) and LACT data (BP-ML03)

description: Work orders, OEM service records, and outage planning
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Planned work can slip a few days; forced outages need OEM records
manual_workaround: Paper work packages
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Uses the group ERP (SYS-G4)

business_process: NERC compliance evidence and event reporting
description: CIP-002 and CIP-003 evidence, EOP-004 and E-ISAC reporting, Regional Entity correspondence
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: EOP-004-4 reports are due by the later of 24 hours or the end of the next business day; evidence must survive an incident
manual_workaround: Offline copies of the reporting Operating Plan and contact lists in the GCC binder
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on SOC facts (BP-G02)

business_process: Group data platform and engineering analytics
description: Historian replicas, production and reliability analytics, and the predictive maintenance model
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Not needed for real-time control; the predictive maintenance model has a manual fallback (P10)
manual_workaround: Engineers use local historians at control centers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Pulls from all three divisions OT DMZs (gap 1)

description: Nominations, measurement tickets, and monthly allocation statements for about 85 shippers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Nominations close monthly; shippers expect statements by contract dates; the three largest shippers asked for SOC 2
manual_workaround: Email nominations and statements
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Production division is the largest shipper

description: Close, consolidation, SEC filings including Form 8-K
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Quarterly and annual filing deadlines; a Form 8-K Item 1.05 filing may be needed during an incident
manual_workaround: Manual close procedures; outside counsel filing agent
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Consolidates all three divisions

business_process: Well servicing and maintenance work orders
description: Scheduling of rigs and crews; maintenance work orders and parts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Rig schedules can run from printed plans for a few days
manual_workaround: Printed rig schedules; radio dispatch
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Work order history also feeds the predictive maintenance model

description: Allocations, state production reports, royalty payments to about 190,000 owners, and joint interest billing
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Monthly payment cycle; late payment carries statutory interest in several states and owner complaints
manual_workaround: Delay the cycle a few days; estimated payments
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Uses SYS-G1 sign-in; monthly exports to a finance file share (P08 data theft target)

description: Time capture, payroll, benefits
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll for 45,000 employees runs biweekly
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions

description: Interpretation, reserves, and development planning
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Planning work, not operations; confidentiality matters more than availability
manual_workaround: Wait for restore
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Trade secret; protected on the group platform
